newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH OCT RAW WOOD PURCHASES HIT RECORD HIGHS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH OCT RAW WOOD PURCHASES HIT RECORD HIGHS.

text.p: The forest industry's raw wood purchases from private forests rose to 7.2 million cubic metres in October -- the highest amount in any month during the 1990s, the Finnish Forest Research Institute (METLA) said in a statement on Friday.

The October raw wood purchase volume was 3.1 million cubic metres higher than in September, METLA said, adding the figure clearly surpassed the previous record in any single month -- 5.4 million cubic metres in June 1995.
In January-October, the Finnish forest industry's raw wood purchases from domestic private forests totalled 24.4 million cubic metres, down 8.1 million cubic metres or 25 percent year-on-year.
Private forest owners' markings for sale of raw wood also increased sharply in October, METLA said in a separate statement. Markings rose 62 percent year-on-year to 4.3 million cubic metres.
January-October markings at 17 million cubic metres were still 33 percent down on the year-ago period, it said.
